title: A request the mock did not match, an interaction never called and a test that throws fail their tests as pact-jvm's do; a @Pact method no test ran fails the class; @PactIgnore leaves a test alone.

rows.row: A request that did not match, or an interaction never called

why: consumer-test-migration.md, pact-jvm: a request that did not match, or an interaction never called, fails the test with pact-jvm's message; a test that throws fails with its own error, what the mock found printed beside it; neither records a contract; `@Pact` methods no test ran fail the class; `@PactIgnore` is left alone. provider-test-migration.md: the engine's logs go through SLF4J to the logger `io.pact.janus.engine` (ADR 0061).
note: The engine's warning of the request it did not match is the log line: the JVM suite runs with RUST_LOG=warn.

fails: The following requests were not received
the client could not read the order
The following methods annotated with @Pact were not executed during the test: PactJvmTestFailures.unused

stderr:

get an order for a test that throws
